customManagers.description: Go module requirements in the generated go.mod. The `v` is captured inside currentValue because the go datasource reports versions v-prefixed; leaving it outside the group makes the replacement render `vv5.11.0`. The `go 1.25.7` toolchain floor above is a hand-maintained tracking value (see the template comment), not a dependency pin -- it still never matches, because this pattern requires a literal `v` that only require(...) entries have.
Maven groupId/artifactId/version triples (dependencies and plugins) in the generated pom.xml
Gradle short-form dependency coordinates in the generated build.gradle.kts

Kotlin Gradle plugin version in the generated build.gradle.kts. The hand-maintained integration_tests/kotlin-jdbc-ext/build.gradle.kts carries the same plugin block but is a real file, so the native gradle manager (scoped above) handles it instead of this regex.
npm dependencies and devDependencies in the generated package.json
PEP 508 >= pins in the generated pyproject.toml, including the two comma-separated deps on the snowflake line
Cargo table-form dependency pins ({ version = "..." }) in the generated integration Cargo.toml

Cargo bare-string dependency pins (`dep = "version"`, no feature table) in the generated integration Cargo.toml. Renovate's RE2 engine has no negative lookahead, so this whitelists the two deps that currently use this shape (`url`, `rust_decimal`) instead of excluding [package]'s name/version/edition, which share the same `key = "value"` syntax but are not dependencies. Add new bare-string deps to the alternation if the template grows one.
Packagist require pins in the generated composer.json
NuGet PackageReference pins in the generated .csproj
Hex (Elixir) `~>` pins in the generated mix.exs

A major bump needs a human to read a changelog, so it is ungrouped and gets its own PR instead of riding along with unrelated minor/patch updates for six other drivers. Same rationale as the majors/minor split in .github/dependabot.yml. Must stay last -- it overrides the groupName set by the per-datasource rules above.
